messages:
maria_pm: Quick sync — I want to lock scope for the next obs sprint. primary asks: dashboard templates for cost/error slices, lightweight tracing hook to tie requests to model variants, and rollout metrics for canary. Need launch criteria by EOD Fri.

sam_eng: low-lift dashboard templates sound doable. tracing hook might be trickier because of cross-service headers. can we narrow the hook to model-id + request-id first?

aj_research: model-id + request-id is sufficient for most regressions. we should also capture config labels (quantize/64->8) to debug perf vs quality.

cecilia_sre: logging those headers increases trace volume. we need sampling guidance. propose 1% baseline + 100% for failing requests (HTTP 5xx) and for canaries.

maria_pm: agreed on sampling. can we make sampling policy configurable per-customer in the console? that's an enterprise ask.

eli_design: UI note — for cost slices we should show both token-level cost and infra cost. customers ask to compare model vs infra cost side-by-side.

sam_eng: infra cost attribution requires mapping GPU-hours to requests. we can approximate with host/pool attribution + average token count per model. accurate but not perfect.

aj_research: we should surface a 'unit cost' estimate per model variant (tokens * model_unit_cost + infra_amortized) so customers can compare.

maria_pm: launch criteria suggestion: 1) templates for top 4 cost/error slices, 2) tracing hook with model-id & request-id + sampling policy UI, 3) per-route canary metrics (latency, p50/p95, error rate, cost estimate), 4) basic rollout controls (canary %, rollback trigger).

cecilia_sre: add reliability gate: instrumentation must not increase median latency by >2ms and must respect sampling config.

sam_eng: technical risk: adding model labels to headers means touching SDKs and internal agents. timeline estimate: core runtime + backend + console — ~3 sprints.

eli_design: minimal UI wireframes attached? (I'll drop in figma after this thread). for now I sketched a compact 'cost slice' card that fits dashboard rows.

maria_pm: customers we should validate with: Acme AI (heavy gen), FinCorp (compliance, wants per-route cost), Searchly (high rps). i'll loop them into a short alpha.

aj_research: regression detection: we can compute delta on eval prompts and real traffic. recommend tying quality regression alerts to a small seeded promptset + traffic-derived sampled prompts.

cecilia_sre: for rollout triggers, specify thresholds: error rate + absolute error count (to avoid noise on low volume routes). propose p95 latency increase >20% OR error rate >1% AND >50 errors in window => rollback.

sam_eng: okay for implementation, we also need a fallback policy: if new model variant fails, route to previous stable variant automatically. runtime already has fallback hooks — we just need console controls.

maria_pm: deciding scope cuts: if timeline slips, drop 'infra-accurate cost' (we keep model unit cost) and postpone per-customer sampling UI to next sprint. focus on templates + tracing hook + canary metrics + rollout controls.

eli_design: fine by design. will prepare compact views for canary metrics and an expanded 'slice deep-dive' for later.

sam_eng: quick question — storage for sampled traces: retention/cost? we'll need to cap retention per project and have TTLs.

cecilia_sre: default retention 7d, adjustable up to 90d for enterprise customers (with cost warning). logs and traces billed separately.

maria_pm: next steps: sam/aj/cecilia to draft a tech spec (include sampling algorithm + header schema + fallback control APIs) by Tue. eli to deliver wireframes by Wed. i'll compile launch criteria doc and customer alpha invite list by Thu.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: created branch feature/obs-canary-controls, CI started. build #482 queued.

sam_eng: noted. I'll pair with aj on header schema doc. cc @maria_pm for product review when ready.

maria_pm: thanks — short, focused sprint. ping here with blockers. :raised_hands:
